description: Source, duplication, and validation protocol matrix for moving from structural AI pressure to forecast-grade labour-market claims. This artifact does not change the headline V7 score.

non_duplication_policy.decision: Do not create a second realised-risk model while v5-realized-risk.json, labour-monitor.json, postings-monitor.json, and ai-in-singapore.json already exist. Forecast-readiness references those owners and records missing validation gates.

inputs.label: Vacancy trend
inputs.transformation: Quarterly and four-quarter movement are computed from official MOM vacancy-rate and vacancy-count series, with the latest report enrichment retained in the labour monitor.
inputs.granularity: Broad occupation clusters and industry/occupation aggregates; not detailed 5-digit SSOC vacancy truth.
inputs.non_duplication_rule: Reuse the existing labour-monitor and multi-period validation owners; do not create a second vacancy monitor.
inputs.next_step: Use as an outcome in q+1, q+2, and q+4 forecast-horizon tests against frozen structural snapshots.

inputs.label: Vacancy rate
inputs.transformation: Direct published vacancy-rate series, with Q4 2025 report-table enrichment where the feed lagged at build time.
inputs.non_duplication_rule: Keep vacancy rates as labour-monitor fields and source-map entries; do not copy them into occupation records.
inputs.next_step: Add an outcome panel that stores rates by quarter for each cluster and frozen score vintage.

inputs.label: Recruitment minus resignation
inputs.transformation: Deterministic net pressure: recruitment_rate minus resignation_rate from official MOM/SingStat series or current-quarter report enrichment.
inputs.granularity: Broad occupation clusters, with annual/quarterly availability depending on the source feed.
inputs.non_duplication_rule: Keep the computed net pressure in the labour monitor; forecast tests should reference it by source field.
inputs.next_step: Use net pressure as a secondary realised-labour outcome, not as a headline-score multiplier.

inputs.label: Retrenchment incidence
inputs.transformation: Counts come from the official quarterly retrenchment series; incidence per 1,000 employees comes from the MOM labour-market report table.
inputs.granularity: Broad occupation clusters, not 5-digit SSOC occupations.
inputs.non_duplication_rule: Keep retrenchment as a labour-monitor outcome and do not expose it as occupation-level displacement evidence.
inputs.next_step: Include as a low-frequency stress signal in forecast-horizon validation.

inputs.label: Wage movement
inputs.transformation: Raw annual wage series is present, but forecast-grade movement needs a long-window and real-wage transform before it should be used as an outcome.
inputs.granularity: Broad occupation groups and sex splits; annual, sample-survey based.
inputs.non_duplication_rule: Do not duplicate gross_wage_median or sector wage anchors; build a separate wage-outcome transform only if it becomes a validation outcome.
inputs.next_step: Create a wage-outcome panel with 5-year nominal and CPI-adjusted movement, then label it broad-group only.

inputs.label: Postings volume
inputs.transformation: Observed postings are normalized from MyCareersFuture and employer ATS snapshots into 30-day/90-day volume and trend fields.
inputs.granularity: Occupation-level where title/alias matching succeeds, but source coverage is partial and the current snapshot is stale-sensitive.
inputs.non_duplication_rule: Use the existing postings monitor; add scheduled snapshots rather than creating another postings dataset.
inputs.next_step: Schedule monthly snapshots and deduplicate stable source IDs before using postings volume as a realised outcome.

inputs.label: AI-skill share in postings
inputs.transformation: Raw postings already carry ai_tools_mentioned and top_tools counts, but an AI-skill share needs a fixed dictionary, denominator, and time series.
inputs.granularity: Occupation/role proxy where postings match; not official statistics.
inputs.non_duplication_rule: Extend postings-monitor fields with shares after snapshots exist; do not build a separate AI-skills crawler.
inputs.next_step: Add a versioned AI-skill dictionary and compute share = AI-skill postings / matched postings by month and occupation.

inputs.label: Firm AI adoption
inputs.transformation: Official firm-size and sector adoption metrics are retained as context. They are not mapped to detailed occupations until a transparent sector-to-occupation adoption model is built.
inputs.granularity: Firm-size and broad sector, not occupation-level.
inputs.non_duplication_rule: Keep national adoption data in ai-in-singapore.json and forecast-readiness; do not multiply it into V7 occupation scores.
inputs.next_step: Build a near-term adoption sidecar only after mapping sector adoption to occupation industry footprints with confidence tiers.

inputs.label: Out-of-sample forecast protocol
inputs.transformation: Freeze structural scores at time t and compare against official outcome panels at t+1Q, t+2Q, and t+4Q.
inputs.granularity: Protocol supports broad cluster outcomes now and can expand to occupation-level outcomes only when reliable data exists.
inputs.non_duplication_rule: Extend the existing backtest family with forecast horizons; do not treat current cluster validation as a causal forecast.
inputs.next_step: Harness and outcome panels are built with post_baseline_quarters_available = 0; horizons activate as MOM publishes Q3 2026+ data, with promotion gated on at least 4 post-baseline quarters.

validation_protocol.claim_boundary: V7 may claim structural pressure and directional validation. It should not claim forecast-grade occupation displacement until the gates below pass out of sample.
validation_protocol.score_freeze: Use data/snapshots/occupations-v7-2026-05.json as the first V7 frozen baseline.
promotion_gates: At least four observed quarters after the frozen score baseline.
High-risk groups show weaker vacancy or postings movement than low-risk groups in at least two horizons.
High-confidence score segments outperform low-confidence segments.
Any combined forecast layer remains a sidecar until source granularity and validation results are published.
No occupation page presents cluster-level outcomes as detailed SSOC evidence.

next_steps: Do not alter V7 headline scoring.
Materialize outcome panels under data/outcomes/ only from existing official labour/postings owners.
Add monthly postings snapshots before computing AI-skill share trends.
Forecast-horizon harness is built (status pending_sufficient_quarters); rerun as each MOM quarter lands and promote only past the 4-quarter gate.
Promote any forecast layer only as a separate sidecar with confidence labels and source granularity.
